task: Refactor Proposal Rehearsal slide presentation modal into true 100vw x 100vh immersive theater fullscreen
problemIdentified: In TitleApprovalPage and CreateProjectPage, the presentation modal used position: fixed without a portal inside DashboardLayout. Because an ancestor (.cms-route-enter) has transform/will-change properties, a new containing block was formed, trapping the modal inside the content body with the app Header and Sidebar remaining visible outside it, surrounded by stark white gutters instead of a true fullscreen presentation.
solutionApplied: Engineered canonical ProposalRehearsalModal utilizing createPortal to document.body, escaping all ancestor layout containing blocks. Applied deep obsidian theater canvas (bg-[#05070B]), dynamic 16:9 canvas scaling (maxHeight/maxWidth formulas), HTML5 native Fullscreen API integration, full keyboard navigation (Arrow keys, Space, Home, End, F, Esc), body scroll locking, floating side navigation chevrons, and interactive slide scrubber pills.

verificationResults.playwrightVisualAudit: Verified 100vw x 100vh modal bounds (w=1440, h=900 desktop; w=390, h=844 mobile) in light and dark modes with 0 errors
